intro.narration: Out on the neighborhood street. Night. A table blocks the middle of the road.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Well, well, well! It's you! You beat Lolo, and now you feel like a winner?

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Grandchild. I'm on your side now. Let's tag-team.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Huh?! Lolo?! You're teaming up with your own grandkid?! Traitor!

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: That's my blood. Of course I'm on their side.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Let's box Marites in. I've got your back. Just lead with the three.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Bring it! Two of you? I can take you both! Chat first, cards later!

win.speaker: ate_marites
win.text: You beat me?! Two against one, that's not even fair!

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: Just teamwork, dear. That's how it goes around here.

win.narration: Lolo laughed out loud. It was the first time you'd ever seen him this happy.

lose.speaker: ate_marites
lose.text: HA! Even two of you, still me! Queen of the street!

lose.speaker: lolo_carding
lose.text: That's harsh, Marites. That's my grandchild.

lose.speaker: lolo_carding
lose.text: Let's go again. Don't give up.

lines.speaker: lolo_carding
lines.text: She's almost out, kid. Box her in now!
